items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And then Chuck Mangione was there, he came and he supported that... So when we played together we took that 50% and split it up.

ctx.x: Mmm. Why do you think we called you?

No though then I talked to Al and Jeff and Joe and I said, “Tell them the same thing I said.” So what would happen, the first few times you know they wouldn’t hire us. And the contractor would come and say, “If I come back here I’m going to tell everybody that © Fillius Jazz Archive -28-

there’s no trumpets here, I have to bring in trumpets and somebody’s not going to work.” So just think about that. So then they didn’t want to pay. See they didn’t want to pay so Chuck Mangione actually — I made a proposal to the musicians union. I said, “You know if a saxophone player plays and he plays clarinet and saxophone he gets extra money. I said “That’s good, I said, “I think that’s right.” “Play three and sometimes get double scale for that.” So the second tenor player is making double scale and the…
